t: The Self-Building Railway: A Case Study in Emergent AI Collaboration
s: Pipulate, a local-first framework prioritizing computational sovereignty, demonstrates how explicit, durable code (Nix, Python, HTMX) facilitates human-AI collaboration, validating emergent architecture via AI analysis of its own design principles.
sub: Pipulate framework: Local-first, computational sovereignty, durable stack (Nix, Python, HTMX)
AI-Human Collaboration: Structured workflows, 'AI on Rails' vs. agentic AI, WET > DRY philosophy
Architectural Patterns: Nix for reproducibility, modern L.A.M.P. stack, Jupyter-to-workflow model, MCP for AI interaction
'Fire-and-Forget' & Endosymbiosis: Workflow state persistence mirrors AI ephemeral nature; AI integration as cognitive enhancement
